author: awesome_apricot
body:
yeah so Sunrise, Shiro and I were on TS and messing around on my server, when Sunrise placed a bed, then told us to place a slab over the top...
When he woke up.. There were some pretty hilarious results XD

And of course I had to get in on the action...

All whilst Shiro was there with his "wand" shouting "RISE MY MINIONS!"
Pretty damn funny stuff XD
